business_problem: ADNOC sought to increase production capacity at its offshore SARB field and improve drilling efficiency and optimization.
solution_summary: At ADNOC's offshore SARB field, remote monitoring, smart well operations, and production-management technologies are integrated at a remote control center on Zirku Island, enabling remote field operations. Within the deployed AI solutions, AIQ's DrillRep and OptiDrill process daily drilling data reports and rig sensor data from the field's rigs and wells, providing insights and actions to drilling operations to improve drilling efficiency and optimize the drilling process. The source does not identify data-transfer interfaces, a storage system, model types, or further processing architecture, so these are not inferred. ADNOC attributes the field's increased production capacity and reduced costs and emissions to the implementation of advanced digital technologies overall; it does not attribute those outcomes solely to DrillRep or OptiDrill.

business_outcome: ADNOC reported a 25% increase in SARB's production capacity, alongside enhanced drilling efficiency and optimization. It also reported reduced costs and emissions from the field's digitalization.
